reviewNotes: Elliott's complete four-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, retaining his literary voice and clinic and Night Market contexts, with the player placeholder exact.

winter_17.000.source: A fleet of exotic merchants, traveling the world in search of riches beyond imagination... what an adventure!
winter_17.000.translation: O flotă de negustori exotici care călătoresc prin lume în căutarea unor bogății mai presus de imaginație... ce aventură!

marriage_Mon.000.source: Hello, @. I'm just watching the waves from here.
marriage_Mon.000.translation: Salut, @. Doar privesc valurile de aici.

summer_9.001.source: My back has been hurting, doctor... you know, with all the hunching over to write my novel.
summer_9.001.translation: Mă doare spatele, doctore... știi, de la cât am stat aplecat ca să-mi scriu romanul.

summer_9.000.source: Hello there. What brings you to this terrible place?
summer_9.000.translation: Salut. Ce te aduce în locul acesta îngrozitor?
